question: Telephones, cellular telecommunications, pagers, telephone exchanges, and radar are examples of which industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Information Technology and Electronics Industry.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Telephones, cellular telecommunications, pagers, telephone exchanges, and radar** are all examples of electronic devices used for communication and information transfer.
 
• **The Information Technology and Electronics Industry **deals with the design, development, and manufacturing of electronic devices, software, and systems for** communication**, **computing**, and **entertainment.**
 
 
• Transistor sets, televisions, telephones, cellular telecom, pagers, telephone exchange, radars, computers, etc. come under this industry.
 
 
 
• This industry is one of the fastest-growing globally, driven by advancements in technology and increasing demand for electronic devices and systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cement Industry **deals with the **production and sale of cement** used for construction purposes.
 
• **Automobile Industry** deals with the manufacturing and sale of vehicles and their components.
 
 
• The industry’s principal products are **passenger automobiles** and light trucks, including pickups, vans, and **sport utility vehicles**.
 
 
 
• **Chemical Industry** deals with the **production and sale of chemicals used in** various industries, such as **pharmaceuticals**, **agriculture**, and **manufacturing.**
